description: Evidence manifest proving artifact and report output files were synchronized to the platform file-server or object storage.
path_rules: absolute paths, UNC paths, drive-qualified paths, and parent traversal are invalid
durable metadata must store relative_path, not source or destination absolute paths
status_rules: sync_status must be synced for production-ready evidence
source_exists and destination_exists must both be true
artifact_count and report_output_count must match the file records
sha256 must be a 64-character lowercase hex digest
notes: This validator checks captured evidence only. The future platform sync worker should perform copying/hash calculation and then emit this manifest.
